shortDescription: Thai Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas is sticking with the government’s forecast for 2.5% economic growth this year despite the surge in oil prices, according to Bloomberg.

title: Thai Finance Minister Keeps 2.5% Growth Forecast Despite Oil Price Surge
